packageRules.description: Node is pinned in mise.toml and in the root engines field; bump both together.
pnpm is pinned in mise.toml and in packageManager; bump both together.
The Mantine MCP server is pinned to the Mantine version the UI uses.
The spikes are throwaway probes outside the workspace; they keep their own ranges.

The e2e job's container image ships the browsers of one Playwright version. This group moves it with @playwright/test on a major bump only: the later non-major rule renames the group for minor, patch and digest updates, and its weekly PR carries both. tests/repo/src/ci.test.ts fails a split. After the GitHub Actions rule, which also matches the image.

CODEX_VERIFIED_ON and CODEX_SHA512 are the Codex release 10db runs and the checksum its download must have. Their bump is a PR of its own, because only the live test, which CI never runs, can verify it.
prBodyNotes: Before merging: run `TENDB_LIVE_CODEX=1 pnpm --filter @10db/daemon exec vitest run test/codex.live.test.ts`. It fetches this release into the live tests' own folder (~/Library/Application Support/10db/live-tests/tools, never the copy the running app uses), checks it against the checksum in this PR, and runs on it. It must pass; CI never runs it.

prBodyNotes: Before merging: run `TENDB_LIVE_CLAUDE=1 pnpm --filter @10db/daemon exec vitest run src/sessions/claude-adapter.live.test.ts`. packageRules.description: playwright-core drives the pinned Chromium headless shell that takes the Workbench's pictures (BROWSER_PIN in apps/daemon/src/pictures/browser-pin.ts), which must be the build the new release's browsers.json names. Its bump is a PR of its own that moves BROWSER_PIN with it, because only the live test, which CI never runs, can verify the pair.
prBodyNotes: Before merging: set BROWSER_PIN's version and URL to the chromium-headless-shell build in the new playwright-core's browsers.json, download that zip and record its sha512 (`sha512-` and the base64 digest), then run `TENDB_LIVE_BROWSER=1 pnpm --filter @10db/daemon exec vitest run src/pictures/browser.live.test.ts`. It fetches the build into the live tests' own folder, checks it against the checksum in this PR, and proves the proxy, the sandbox and the overlays on it. It must pass; CI never runs it.

packageRules.description: Every update that isn't a major version lands in one weekly PR, except the agent CLIs' and the pictures' browser driver, which need their live tests.
A major version opens a PR only after its box is ticked on the Dependency Dashboard.
